notes: ownedRoots is the canonical package-root allowlist derived from the packages implemented by TSTS main a80a5da32ee5335928e44ee3fe9357fe1e51056e under packages/tsts/src/internal.

cmd/tsgo is deliberately not owned: at pin c78d39e7 it depends on internal/lsp, internal/ls, internal/project, internal/format, and internal/api, all hard-excluded. The product CLI surface is TSTS-owned assembly.
testOnlyRoots are owned test-support source: analyzed under the test scope, importable from test scope only. A production import of a test-only root is a contradiction.

internal/testutil/{autoimporttestutil,lsptestutil,projecttestutil} are hard-excluded carve-outs inside the testutil test-only root: they exist to support excluded LSP/project tests and their dependency closure reaches internal/lsp and internal/project.
editor-service exclusions follow the packet plus Porter exclusion records: internal/format and internal/api are recorded as outside the standalone compiler runtime port.

internal/execute (the tsc CLI driver, tsc.go/watcher.go) is unselected by ADR 0003: at pin c78d39e7 its tsc.go binds hard-excluded editor-service packages (internal/format, internal/ls/lsutil), and the TSTS product CLI is product-owned assembly that deliberately omits those paths. Its subpackages incremental/ and tsc/ remain owned; build/ (the tsc --build driver mode, whose tests run through the driver harness) and the harness tsctests/ follow the driver into unselected.
